# Annual Renewal Proposal — Bluebird Logistics

Proposal date: 2026-08-29

## Customer and contract summary

- Customer: Bluebird Logistics (CUST-1002)
- Active contract: CTR-2025-0142
- Current plan: Professional
- Current committed seats: 60
- Contract term: 2025-11-15 through 2026-11-14
- Billing: Annual
- Account owner: m.lee@example.com
- Special terms: custom SLA 99.95%
- Renewal pricing policy: pricing_v2 (effective 2026-01-01)

## Usage summary

For May through July 2026, active seats increased from 54 to 58, a 7.4074% increase. Peak active seats were 58, and average API usage was 322,000.00 calls per month. Under the current policy, the greater of the current 60-seat commitment and the 58-seat peak is rounded up to the next 10 seats, producing a recommended commitment of 60 seats.

## Pricing

All amounts are in USD.

| Calculation | Monthly | Annual |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 60 seats × $25.00 list price | $1,500.00 | $18,000.00 |
| Less 5% volume discount | −$75.00 | −$900.00 |
| Less 0% loyalty discount | −$0.00 | −$0.00 |
| **Total after discounts** | **$1,425.00** | **$17,100.00** |

The 5% volume discount applies at the 50-seat band. No loyalty discount applies on the proposal date because two years of continuous service will be reached on 2027-11-15. The combined 5% discount is below the 20% policy cap.

## Required clauses

12-month term with 60-day auto-renewal notice

Data Processing Addendum v3 attached

Price valid for 30 days from proposal date
